lines.en: I tap on Ami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Ami 的名字,等她接听。

lines.en: I’m not really feeling like doing anything exciting tonight and, not to say that Ami isn’t exciting or anything, but I kind of just want to hang out at home.
lines.zh: 我今晚实在没什么心情搞什么刺激活动,倒不是说 Ami 不刺激什么的,只是我有点想宅在家里。

lines.en: And considering that inviting anyone else over would likely result in more stress than relaxation, my [niece] is the first person that comes to mind for a quiet night in.
lines.zh: 而且考虑到邀请其他人过来,多半是压力大于放松,想安安静静宅一晚时,第一个浮现在我脑海的就是我的 [niece]。

lines.en: : Sensei! Did you know there is a heart next to your name in Ami’s phone?
lines.zh: : Sensei!你知道吗,Ami 的手机里,你的名字旁边有一颗心!

lines.en: The chance for a quiet night dies immediately after being born.
lines.zh: 安静一夜的机会,刚一诞生就当场夭折。

lines.en: : Ayane! Give me my phone back!
lines.zh: : Ayane!把手机还我!

lines.en: : Whoops! Sorry, Sensei! Here’s Ami~
lines.zh: : 哎呀!抱歉,Sensei!Ami 给你~

lines.en: A minor scuffle bleeds through the receiving end of the telephone and Ami eventually finds her correct place in the conversation.
lines.zh: 电话那头传来一阵小小的扭打声,Ami 总算找回了自己在对话中的位置。

lines.en: : Hey. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗨。怎么了?

lines.en: : If you’re just calling to let me know that you’re going to be out late, that’s fine. Ayane is sleeping over anyway.
lines.zh: : 如果你只是想通知我你今晚要晚归,没关系。反正 Ayane 要留宿。

lines.en: : I was actually going to see if you wanted to hang out with me tonight.
lines.zh: : 其实,我是想问你要不要今晚陪我出去。

lines.en: : Ayane! Something came up and you have to go home!
lines.zh: : Ayane!临时有急事,你必须回家了!

lines.en: : Ayane can stay. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : Ayane 留下也没关系。

lines.en: : Is it really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的没关系吗?

lines.en: : Hey! I heard that!
lines.zh: : 喂!我听见了!

lines.en: : Just hang out there and I’ll come meet up with you guys.
lines.zh: : 你们先待着,我过去找你们。

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei...
lines.zh: : 等等!Sensei……

lines.en: : What? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么?怎么了?
: 那个……

lines.en: : I was just wondering if...
lines.zh: : 我只是想问……

lines.en: : Can you buy us ice cream on the way home?
lines.zh: : 回家路上能给我们买冰淇淋吗?

lines.en: : Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 你在逗我?

lines.en: : I love you! Bye!
lines.zh: : 爱你!挂了!

lines.en: : Me too! I love-
lines.zh: : 我也爱——

lines.en: Ami hangs up the phone and my quiet night in has suddenly turned into one more rollercoaster in the amusement park that is life.
lines.zh: Ami 挂断了电话,我的安静宅家之夜,瞬间变成人生这座游乐园里的又一趟过山车。

lines.en: I slide my phone into my pocket, replacing it with my wallet before checking how much cash I have on me.
lines.zh: 我把手机塞回口袋,换上钱包,顺便清点了一下身上的现金。

lines.en: And, before I know it, I find myself in the check out line of a convenience store with several pints of ice cream in my hands.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间,我已经站在便利店的结账队伍里,手里捧着好几品脱冰淇淋。

lines.en: : I’m home...
lines.zh: : 我回来了……

lines.en: I don’t know how I managed to go from “cool guy breezing his way through a brand new life” to “generic [uncle] buying ice cream for girls,” but here we are.
lines.zh: 我都不知道自己是怎么从「潇洒闯荡崭新人生的酷guy」变成「给女孩们买冰淇淋的无聊 [uncle]」的,但事已至此。

lines.en: Granted, I’m also having sex with both of these girls, so I guess I’m not entirely normal.
lines.zh: 当然,考虑到我还和这两个女孩都在上床,我大概本来就不太正常。

lines.en: Granted, I’m also having sex with one of these girls, so I guess I’m not entirely normal.
lines.zh: 当然,考虑到我还和其中一个女孩在上床,我大概本来就不太正常。

lines.en: Either way, I toss the bag directly into the freezer and make my way into the living room to find Ami and Ayane already in their pajamas.
lines.zh: 无论如何,我把袋子直接塞进冰箱,走进客厅,发现 Ami 和 Ayane 已经换好睡衣了。

lines.en: : Welcome home, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家,Sensei!

lines.en: : Where are our goodnight kisses?
lines.zh: : 我们的晚安吻呢?

lines.en: : Are you two already going to sleep?
lines.zh: : 你们这就准备睡了?

lines.en: : Will you kiss me if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 我要是说是,你会吻我吗?

lines.en: : Any response to that, Ami?
lines.zh: : 对此有什么回应吗,Ami?

lines.en: : Will you kiss me if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 我要是说是,你会吻我吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Even think about it and I will sew your mouth shut for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 会的。连想都别想,否则我缝上你的嘴,缝到宇宙终结。

lines.en: : I’m not kissing anyone.
lines.zh: : 谁的吻我都不吻。

lines.en: : In fact, the only reason I came back at all was to unwind.
lines.zh: : 说白了,我会回来纯粹是想放松一下。

lines.en: : And to spend time with your beloved [niece].
lines.zh: : 以及,陪陪你心爱的 [niece]。

lines.en: : And her best friend. Me.
lines.zh: : 还有她的挚友。也就是我。

lines.en: : Yes. I’m here to spend time with both of you.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是来陪你们俩的。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure the ice cream delivers that message pretty well in the event of my words somehow managing to fall flat.
lines.zh: : 再说了,万一我的话没能把心意传达到,冰淇淋应该也能代为表达。

lines.en: : Thank you! I thought for sure you were gonna be like, “Bahhh ice cream is exhausting” and then just come home without any.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你!我还以为你肯定会来一句「哎,买冰淇淋好累」,然后两手空空回家呢。

lines.en: : Ayane’s been freakin’ out about ice cream all day so we were probably just gonna go get some ourselves if that happened.
lines.zh: : Ayane 为冰淇淋念叨了一整天,真要那样,我们多半就自己出去买了。

lines.en: : Not all day...Just for the last ten hours or so.
lines.zh: : 也不是一整天……就最后十个小时左右。

lines.en: : Yeah. All day.
lines.zh: : 对。一整天。

lines.en: : How come it’s just you two tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚怎么就你们俩?

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : Are Ami and I not allowed to hang out alone anymore?
lines.zh: : Ami 和我不许单独出去玩了吗?

lines.en: : Is it because you’ve seen us kiss?
lines.zh: : 还是因为你看到我们接吻了?

lines.en: : Please don’t bring up the kiss, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 别提那个吻,Ayane。

lines.en: : Ami has very soft lips. They’re like two little lemon-flavored pillows.
lines.zh: : Ami 的嘴唇非常软。像两只柠檬味的小枕头。

lines.en: : Can you cut it out, please?!
lines.zh: : 你们能适可而止吗?!

lines.en: : I love you, Ami! Let's kiss again for Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我爱你,Ami!我们再为 Sensei 亲一个!

lines.en: : What I was getting at is that there’s normally a third girl with you.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是,平时跟你们在一起的还有第三个女孩。

lines.en: : The one with the hair and the...weight of the entire universe on her shoulders.
lines.zh: : 那个顶着那头头发、肩上扛着整个宇宙重量的家伙。

lines.en: : Oh, Ayane and I just wanted it to be the two of us tonight.
lines.zh: : 哦,Ayane 和我只是想让今晚只有我们俩。

lines.en: : It’s not like we didn’t want Maya here or anything, but sometimes it’s good for it to just be us two so we can talk about old times and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是不想要 Maya 来什么的,只是偶尔只有我们俩也挺好,可以聊聊过去的事什么的。

lines.en: : You’re [teenager]s. There are no “old times” for you.
lines.zh: : 你们可是 [teenager]。你们哪来的「过去的事」。

lines.en: : Maybe not old times...but times the two of us spent together that no one else knows about.
lines.zh: : 那不算过去的事……但属于只有我们俩知道、别人都不知道的时光。

lines.en: : Isn’t it fun to have secrets like that with someone, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 能和某个人拥有那样的秘密,很有趣吧,Sensei?

lines.en: : I wouldn’t really know.
lines.zh: : 这我还真不知道。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m sure that any “secret” I have would be found out by you two almost immediately.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我敢肯定,我有什么「秘密」,你们俩立刻就能挖出来。

lines.en: : That’s right. So don’t even think about hiding stuff from the original Sensei Love Squad.
lines.zh: : 没错。所以别想对初代 Sensei 爱之小队隐瞒任何事。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say “immediately...” but yeah. We’d find out eventually.
lines.zh: : 倒也不至于「立刻」……但没错,迟早会被我们发现。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Didn’t you have something you wanted to talk to me about, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 哦,对了。你不是有事想跟我说吗,Ayane?

lines.en: : Oh! Uhh...yeah! Soon!
lines.zh: : 哦!呃……对!快了!

lines.en: : Not right now, though! This isn’t really the best time...
lines.zh: : 但不是现在!现在实在不是合适的时机……

lines.en: : What did you have to talk to Sensei about? You never said anything to me.
lines.zh: : 你要跟 Sensei 聊什么?你从来没跟我说过。

lines.en: : Oh, and...umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦,还有……呃……Sensei?

lines.en: : Yes, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Ayane?

lines.en: : If it's okay with you...there's something I'd like to talk about with you soon.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话……我近期有件事想和你聊聊。

lines.en: : Obviously not tonight, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 显然不是今晚,但是……嗯。

lines.en: : Sure. Can I ask what this is about?
lines.zh: : 当然。能问问是什么事吗?

lines.en: : Just...some stuff...
lines.zh: : 就是……一些事……

lines.en: : About?
lines.zh: : 关于什么?

lines.en: : About...
lines.zh: : 关于……

lines.en: : Boobs.
: Please don’t talk to my [uncle] about boobs. Even if you are an honorary member of the original Sensei Love Squad.
lines.zh: : 求你不要跟我的 [uncle] 聊胸。哪怕你是初代 Sensei 爱之小队的荣誉成员。

lines.en: : Okay, I didn’t want to ask the first time I heard it, but this is the second time it’s been mentioned within sixty seconds.
lines.zh: : 好吧,第一次听见的时候我忍住没问,但这是六十秒内第二次提及了。

lines.en: : What exactly is the “Sensei Love Squad?”
lines.zh: : 「Sensei 爱之小队」到底是什么?

lines.en: : A two person organization me and Ayane formed to put all of the followers in their places!
lines.zh: : 一个由我和 Ayane 缔结的两人组织,专门用来治治那些追随者!

lines.en: : That’s right!
lines.zh: : 没错!

lines.en: : Ami and I have spent years fighting for your affection and we will not stand for random pink haired girls walking into your life and trying to take you from us!
lines.zh: : 我和 Ami 为你的爱奋战多年,我们绝不容忍哪个粉毛女孩突然闯进你的生活、试图把你从我们身边抢走!

lines.en: : Even if you’ve technically known those random pink haired girls longer than you’ve known me!
lines.zh: : 哪怕按理说,你认识那些粉毛女孩的时间比认识我还长!

lines.en: : And even if those girls happen to be extremely nice!
lines.zh: : 哪怕那些女孩碰巧人特别好!

lines.en: : And pretty!
lines.zh: : 还特别漂亮!

lines.en: : But with horrible taste in clothes!
lines.zh: : 但衣品烂到家!

lines.en: : But still very pretty!
lines.zh: : 但依然非常漂亮!

lines.en: : No one is going to take me from anyone. I’m not property.
lines.zh: : 没有人能把我从谁那里「抢走」。我不是财产。

lines.en: : Not yet...
lines.zh: : 现在还不是……

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : But really, though! I have no idea what her deal is!
lines.zh: : 不过说真的!我完全搞不懂她是怎么回事!

lines.en: : I’ve known Ami since elementary[school] and I’d never even heard of that Noriko girl until she walked into class.
lines.zh: : 我从小学 [school] 时代就认识 Ami 了,在那位 Noriko 走进教室之前,我压根没听说过这个人。

lines.en: : My memory from all the way back then isn’t really good...so I can’t really think of when I would have seen her either.
lines.zh: : 那么久远的记忆我本来就不太好……所以也想不起来我到底会在哪儿见过她。

lines.en: : She remembers you, though. And so does her sister.
lines.zh: : 但她记得你。她妹妹也记得。

lines.en: : Niki remembers me?!
lines.zh: : Niki 居然记得我?!

lines.en: : Well, she remembers that you exist. I don’t know if you two ever met.
lines.zh: : 嗯,她记得有你这号人。你们俩有没有碰过面我就不知道了。

lines.en: : Isn’t it weird that I’ve never met her if you’ve known her for that long, though?
lines.zh: : 可你跟她认识那么久,我却从来没见过她,这难道不怪吗?

lines.en: : I spent almost every night here once my mom left and...if you two really go back that far...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈走后,我几乎每晚都睡在这里,而且……如果你们俩真的认识那么久……

lines.en: : I just don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我就是想不通。

lines.en: : It’s a confusing situation. I don’t really think I fully understand it yet either, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 这情况确实很绕。完全坦白地说,我自己也没能完全理解。

lines.en: : I remember when he used to tutor and stuff, and he definitely started doing it more around the time we became friends.
lines.zh: : 我记得他以前做家教什么的,而且在我们成为朋友前后,他明显做得更勤了。

lines.en: : What I'm confused about is how someone can just happen to lose somebody they claim to care about for as long as she lost Sensei.
lines.zh: : 让我困惑的是,一个人怎么能把自己声称在乎的人弄丢那么久——像 Noriko 丢掉 Sensei 那样。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that mean like, she doesn’t love him at all? It’s not like we’ve lived anywhere other than here and the old district.
lines.zh: : 那不就等于说,她根本不爱他吗?我们又没在别的地方住过,除了这里和老城区。

lines.en: : Do you think you’d ever lose Sensei for that long? Because I know I wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己有可能把 Sensei 弄丢那么久吗?反正我知道我不会。

lines.en: : Well...circumstances are different for everyone, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……每个人的境遇不一样,但是……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : I don’t think that would ever happen with me. I wouldn't let it.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这种事会发生在我身上。我不会允许。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I’ve decided that Noriko doesn’t love you at all and only I do.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。所以我决定了,Noriko 根本不爱你,爱你的只有我。

lines.en: : And me.
lines.zh: : 还有我。

lines.en: : And Ayane by default, I guess. But she’s too needy and you’ll never pick her.
lines.zh: : 顺便 Ayane 也算默认入队吧。但她太粘人,你永远不会选她。

lines.en: : You’re being a lot meaner than normal about this today...
lines.zh: : 你今天在这件事上,比平时刻薄多了……

lines.en: : You think so? Cause it seems kinda like you’re just not fighting back as hard as you normally do.
lines.zh: : 是吗?我怎么觉得只是你没有像平时那样全力反击而已。

lines.en: : Either way, Noriko might be nice and related to one of my favorite pop stars, but that doesn’t mean that I think she’s at all deserving of your time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 总之,Noriko 人也许不错,还跟我最喜欢的偶像之一沾亲带故,但这不代表我觉得她配得上你的时间,Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t know when you “disappeared” on her, but I know that you’ve been here for me for as long as I’ve needed you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你什么时候在她那里「消失」过,但我知道,从我需要你以来,你一直都在。

lines.en: : So I am obviously your favorite and everything I say goes.
lines.zh: : 所以我显然是你的最爱,我说什么就是什么。

lines.en: : Is that how this works?
lines.zh: : 规则是这样运作的?

lines.en: : Yup! I worked for the love you give me. It’s not fair if you give the same amount to people just because they want it.
lines.zh: : 没错!我付出的努力,才换来你给我的爱。要是有人光凭「想要」就拿到同样多,那太不公平了。

lines.en: : I don’t think “love” is something you should have to work for, but I do know I love you.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得「爱」是拼努力就能换来的东西,但我的确爱你。

lines.en: : Ayane! I-
lines.zh: : Ayane!我——

lines.en: : And you too, Ami.
lines.zh: : 还有你,Ami。

lines.en: : I love both of you guys. You’re pretty much the only family I have now.
lines.zh: : 我爱你们俩。你们差不多是我现在仅剩的家人了。

lines.en: : And sure, you might have a few extra years on me in time spent with him.
lines.zh: : 而且行,你们陪他的年头也许比我多几年。

lines.en: : And sure, you might get to wake up in the same house as him every day while I have to wake up on the other side of town.
lines.zh: : 行,你们也许每天都能跟他在同一个屋檐下醒来,而我在城另一头睁眼。

lines.en: : And sure, he might get to see you walk around the house naked all the time and force you to cook him breakfast in nothing but an apron!
lines.zh: : 行,他也许能天天看你在家里裸奔,还能只让你系一条围裙给他做早餐!

lines.en: Oh, that’s a good idea. I should do that.
lines.zh: 哦,这主意不错。我应该试试。

lines.en: : But I am a better cook with nicer boobs and just as much, if not even more love to give!
lines.zh: : 但我厨艺更好、胸更漂亮,能给出的爱也一点不比你们少,甚至更多!

lines.en: : And sure, I-
lines.zh: : 行,还有我——

lines.en: : Please don’t keep going. That’s more than enough, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 求你别继续了。已经够多了,Ayane。

lines.en: : Fine. But you have to tell me you love me too.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但你必须也说一句你爱我。

lines.en: : After you literally just made the one comparison that no growing girl should ever make to another one?
lines.zh: : 在你刚刚做出了一个正在发育的女孩永远不该对另一个女孩做的比较之后?

lines.en: : Want me to massage them for you? I heard it helps them grow.
lines.zh: : 要我帮你按摩吗?听说按摩能长。

lines.en: : I love you too, okay?! Just keep your hands off of me and my boyf-[uncle]!
lines.zh: : 我也爱你,行了吧?!把手从我身上,还有我的男朋——[uncle] 身上拿开!

lines.en: : Boyf[uncle]?
lines.zh: : 「男朋[uncle]」?

lines.en: : You know what I mean!
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思!

lines.en: : I don’t. Please explain, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。请解释,Ami。

lines.en: : This love squad or whatever really knows what it wants, huh?
lines.zh: : 这支什么爱之小队,还真清楚自己想要什么啊?

lines.en: : Of course. And no matter what it is you might think, there is no one that wants your approval more than the two of us.
lines.zh: : 那当然。而且无论你怎么想,世上没有任何人比我们俩更想要你的认可。

lines.en: : We even formed a whole organization to prove it. The first board meeting is next Saturday.
lines.zh: : 我们甚至为此成立了一个组织。第一次董事会下周六召开。

lines.en: : Some stuff has clearly happened with your past that you either can’t share with us or just...don’t want to-
lines.zh: : 你的过去显然发生过一些事,要么是你没法跟我们分享,要么就是……不想——

lines.en: : And we’re okay with that. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 我们可以接受。勉强算。

lines.en: : It really depends on what kind of stuff happened and what you’re willing to do to make it up to us.
lines.zh: : 具体取决于发生了什么、以及你打算怎么弥补。

lines.en: : But at the end of the day, you’re my Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但归根结底,你是我的 Sensei。

lines.en: : Our Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们的 Sensei。

lines.en: : I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我说什么就是什么。

lines.en: : Fine. But then I get to be his Ayane.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就是他的 Ayane。

lines.en: : Why are you two just staring at me? I told you I’m not going anywhere and that all I wanted to do was relax tonight.
lines.zh: : 你们俩盯着我干嘛?我说了我哪儿也不去,今晚只想放松一下。

lines.en: : I did not sign up for a longform discussion on who wants or deserves me the most.
lines.zh: : 我可没报名参加「谁最想要我、谁配得上我」专题长篇研讨会。

lines.en: : Also, your ice cream is getting cold. Go eat it.
lines.zh: : 还有,你们的冰淇淋要化了。快去吃。

lines.en: : That is literally the point of ice cream, Sensei. Are you so far removed from happy things that you can’t even remember that?
lines.zh: : Sensei,冰淇淋的重点就是边化边吃。你是幸福绝缘体到连这个都忘了吗?

lines.en: The short answer: Yes.
lines.zh: 简短回答:是。

lines.en: The slightly longer answer: Yes. But it’s a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 稍长回答:是。但实际情况要更复杂一点。

lines.en: It’s not that I am entirely devoid of joy or “far removed from happy things.”
lines.zh: 并不是说我完全没有快乐,或者「与幸福绝缘」。

lines.en: It’s that I’ve come to associate them with the subsequent misery that so standardly follows them soon after.
lines.zh: 而是我已经学会把它们与随之而来的、千篇一律的痛苦划上等号。

lines.en: Without joy, there can be no sorrow. And without sorrow, there can be no joy.
lines.zh: 没有欢乐,就没有悲恸。没有悲恸,也就没有欢乐。

lines.en: It’s a multi-tool of a saying that coerces you into either thinking “Things will get better” or “Things will get worse.”
lines.zh: 这句谚语就像一把多功能工具,逼你在「一切会变好」和「一切会更糟」里二选一。

lines.en: But what help does a cycle like that do?
lines.zh: 可这样一个循环,又能帮你什么忙?

lines.en: The first of those two things makes sense and is likely why the damn idea was ever brought up in the first place.
lines.zh: 前半句听起来有道理,这大概也是这个烂点子当初被发明出来的原因。

lines.en: But if you hold those lines of text up to a mirror, the opposite side of that mirror fills up with the concept of perpetual joy being nothing short of impossible.
lines.zh: 但把那几行字举到镜子前,镜子的另一面写满的却是:永恒的快乐根本不存在。

lines.en: And so there is no need to look forward to those happier moments in life-
lines.zh: 于是,人生里那些更快乐的时刻,根本不值得期待——

lines.en: Because things can only get worse from that point on.
lines.zh: 因为从那个顶点开始,一切只会变糟。

lines.en: Think nothing, but feel everything.
lines.zh: 什么都别想,什么都去感受。

lines.en: Distract yourself with sensations when emotions will not do the trick anymore.
lines.zh: 当情绪已经不够用时,用感官麻痹自己。

lines.en: For there are several sensations in this world that are worth any amount of pain they cause in result.
lines.zh: 毕竟这世上有一些感官体验,值得付出它们带来的任何代价。

lines.en: Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美圣名。

lines.en: : Oh good...You’re still awake.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了……你还醒着。

lines.en: : I’m happy to see the love squad continued bonding after I retired for the night.
lines.zh: : 看到爱之小队在我退场之后还在增进感情,我很欣慰。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。

lines.en: : She just sort of passed out like this.
lines.zh: : 她就这样直接睡过去了。

lines.en: : Do you think you could go get my blanket for me? I don’t want to wake her.
lines.zh: : 你能帮我把被子拿来吗?我不想吵醒她。

lines.en: : Aww, look at my [niece] being such a caring and adorable best friend.
lines.zh: : 哇,看看我的 [niece],多么贴心可爱的一位挚友。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Ayane’s been pretty stressed out lately.
lines.zh: : Ayane 最近压力挺大的。

lines.en: : You already know she’s not the type to talk about her feelings and I think it’s starting to catch up to her.
lines.zh: : 你也知道她不是会倾诉的那种人,我觉得最近那些情绪开始反噬她了。

lines.en: : Is she going to be okay?
lines.zh: : 她会没事的吗?

lines.en: : Are you worried?
lines.zh: : 你担心了?

lines.en: : Of course. I’d worry about you the same way.
lines.zh: : 当然。换成是你,我也会一样担心。

lines.en: : She’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 她会没事的。

lines.en: : She just needs some rest.
lines.zh: : 她只是需要好好睡一觉。

lines.en: I grab Ami’s blanket out of her room and bring it to her moments later.
lines.zh: 我从 Ami 房里拿来她的被子,很快给她送回去。

lines.en: Not wanting to move, she asks me to drape it over her and tuck the two of them in, to which I oblige because, as I mentioned earlier, I’m now nothing more than a generic [uncle].
lines.zh: 她懒得动,让我帮她们把被子盖好、掖好边。我照办了——毕竟正如我之前所说,我现在不过是个无聊的普通 [uncle]。

lines.en: A generic [uncle] who routinely fucks both his [niece] and her best friend, and wants nothing more than their unending happiness.
lines.zh: 一个普通的 [uncle]:例行公事般地和他的 [niece] 及她的挚友上床,除此之外别无所求,只盼她们幸福无尽。

lines.en: Their unending happiness and the chance to screw them both at once eventually.
lines.zh: 幸福无尽,以及最终有机会把她们俩同时收入囊中。

lines.en: I go to sleep.
lines.zh: 我去睡了。

lines.en: A generic [uncle] who routinely fucks his [niece]’s best friend and proceeds to smile and act like nothing ever happened while tucking the two of them in.
lines.zh: 一个普通的 [uncle]:例行公事般地和他的 [niece] 的挚友上床,然后微笑着给她们掖好被子,装作什么都没有发生。

lines.en: I love Ami. I really do.
lines.zh: 我爱 Ami。真的。

lines.en: But a part of me hopes that she dreams of what I do to Ayane when she falls asleep tonight.
lines.zh: 但我有一部分希望,她今晚入睡后,会梦见我对 Ayane 做了什么。

lines.en: I go back to my room and pass out to the idea of her waking up from that dream.
lines.zh: 我回到自己房间,想着她从那个梦里惊醒的画面,沉沉睡去。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
